verdict.rationale: The evidence documents scheduled gradual rollouts, a manual emergency disable switch, and Infra Analytics alerts that 'catch regressions'. Nothing ties metrics to a rollout so that a regression automatically rolls the release back. Alerts plus a manual kill switch is a user-assembled arrangement, and Autotune's traffic shifting toward a winning variant is an adjacent experimentation feature, not rollback.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
